score.note: DIVERGENT-BY-DESIGN is scored positively: the candidate surfaced a defect the legacy estate has been carrying. It is not a pass -- it is a finding that needs a business decision, not a code change.

money.note: Money totals cover fields declaring decimal places only. Differences on unscaled identifiers (NPA-NXX, LATA, CIC, HHMMSS) are counted separately because their arithmetic difference is not an amount.
